messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-9024 fired for #eng-oncall — alert: inference_queue_length high (cell=prod-west, value=4987), severity=high, runbook=https://redwood/runbooks/autoscaler-capacity
pagerduty-bot: Page sent to rotation eng-oncall (PD-9024) — please acknowledge
sam: acked — I'm oncall and taking this
maya: looking at grafana https://grafana/d/xyz/inference-overview — queue jumped at 02:06 UTC, p95 latency climbing
jason: grabbing autoscaler logs: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/autoscaler --since=10m`
maya: prometheus snippet: `inference_queue_length{cell="prod-west"} 4987` and `inference_average_wait_ms 2340`
sam: running `kubectl get nodes -o wide` — seeing many pods Pending with reason=InsufficientGPUs
jason: cloud console shows VM provisioning failures: "QuotaExceeded: GPUs quota hit in us-west-2"
nina: confirmed with cloud team, ephemeral GPU quota exhausted, automated quota request denied — manual increase needed
liam: initiating reserved-pool allocation: `infractl allocate --pool=inference-reserve-usw2 --gpus=6`
maria: can we route low-priority traffic to cpu-only fallback model to buy time?
sam: good idea — applying 40% diversion to fallback-cpu via traffic-router now
jason: route change pushed; monitoring impact
incident-bot: Escalation rule: if queue not reduced 15% in 6m, page infra-leads
liam: reserved nodes booting: 2/6 Ready after ~3m
sam: checking pod statuses: many Pending -> new nodes should clear backlog as kube-scheduler binds pods
maya: queue down to 1900, avg_wait_ms 980 — improvement but still high :frowning: 
support: FYI posted to #support: "High inference latencies observed; investigating. Some customers may see errors or long waits." Support acknowledged
nina: cloud team approved temporary +8 GPU quota, ETA ~14m for quota to be applied
liam: continuing reserved allocation; will also request a longer-term quota increase via ticket
sam: once new quota/nodes are ready we'll scale HPA limits and drain fallback routing gradually
jason: note: several pods showing CrashLoopBackOff when scheduled on new nodes — investigating image pull/taints
maria: suggest staggered restart of inference-workers to avoid KV-cache cold storm once capacity stabilizes
sam: agreed — will roll in 10% batches after capacity back to normal
incident-bot: PD-9024 acknowledged by sam; state=ack
sam: I'm owning incident until queue < 500 and avg_wait_ms < 600ms
liam: reserved pool now 6/6 Ready, kube-scheduler moving pods to new nodes
maya: metrics now queue=420, avg_wait_ms=480 — back to acceptable range :thumbsup:
sam: impact summary: customers experienced increased latency and intermittent 5xxs for ~22 minutes. Root cause: cloud GPU quota exhaustion prevented autoscaler from provisioning new capacity. Mitigation: diverted traffic to CPU fallback model, allocated reserved GPU pool, and requested temporary quota bump. Follow-up: cloud quota increase, review autoscaler fallback thresholds, add prewarm policy for critical cells
sam: creating incident ticket in ops JIRA with initial timeline and mitigation steps
sam: handing off monitoring to night shift (nina) for 3h; nina, can you own verification and follow-ups?
nina: taking handoff, will coordinate with cloud for permanent quota bump and schedule postmortem
sam: thanks all, great work :heart:
pagerduty-bot: PD-9024 status updated: resolved (manual mitigations applied; follow-up required)
